moments.title: Community Shield Showdown
moments.blurb: The 2026 FA Community Shield will see Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup holders Manchester City at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff this Sunday.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts
angles.copy: Cardiff's Principality Stadium is set for a massive clash this Sunday as Arsenal face Manchester City in the Community Shield. Who's lifting the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Man City
angles.copy: It's Premier League champions vs FA Cup holders! Arsenal and Manchester City go head-to-head in the Community Shield this weekend. Predictions, anyone?

moments.title: Premier League Returns
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off on Friday, August 21, with Arsenal hosting Coventry City.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League season begins next Friday, August 21st. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Arsenal Opener
angles.copy: Arsenal kick off the new Premier League season at home to Coventry City on August 21st. Big opening fixture for the Gunners!

moments.title: Boomtown Festival Underway
moments.blurb: The immersive Boomtown Festival is currently taking place in Hampshire, UK, running from August 12-16, 2026.

angles.name: Chapter 13 Begins
angles.copy: Boomtown Fair is in full swing in Hampshire! Who's lost themselves in the incredible world of Chapter 13 this week?

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The UK festival season continues with Boomtown this week! Sending good vibes to everyone enjoying the music and magic.

moments.title: Regional Festivals This Weekend
moments.blurb: Several smaller festivals are happening across the UK this weekend, including The Magpies Festival in York (14-15 Aug), Country Calling UK in Chelmsford (14-16 Aug), and Jurassic Fields in Bridport (14-16 Aug).

angles.name: York Festival
angles.copy: If you're in Yorkshire, The Magpies Festival kicks off on Friday! Who's heading to York for a weekend of live music?

angles.name: Country Calling
angles.copy: Chelmsford's Country Calling UK festival starts Friday! Get ready for some great country music vibes this weekend.

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the Official UK Number 1 spot for a record-breaking 20th week (chart dated Aug 7-13, 2026), while Ariana Grande sees two tracks in the Top 5.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make history with 'Rein Me In' at UK Number 1 for a 20th week. Unstoppable!

angles.name: Ariana's Chart Takeover
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is dominating the charts with two tracks in the Top 5 this week, including new entry 'Petal' at No. 4!

moments.title: Mark Knopfler Turns 77
moments.blurb: Today, August 12, marks the 77th birthday of Dire Straits frontman and legendary guitarist Mark Knopfler, born in Glasgow in 1949.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Mark Knopfler! His iconic guitar work with Dire Straits gave us so many timeless tracks. What's your favourite?

moments.title: James Morrison's 42nd Birthday
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for hits like 'You Give Me Something' and 'Broken Strings', celebrates his 42nd birthday tomorrow, August 13.

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 42nd Birthday to the soulful James Morrison tomorrow! Which of his tracks always hits you right in the feels?

moments.title: Feargal Sharkey Turns 67
moments.blurb: Feargal Sharkey, the distinctive voice of The Undertones and a successful solo artist, turns 67 tomorrow, August 13.

angles.name: Teenage Kicks
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday tomorrow to Feargal Sharkey! From 'Teenage Kicks' to 'A Good Heart', what's your favourite from The Undertones frontman?

moments.title: Joe Jonas's 37th Birthday
moments.blurb: Joe Jonas, member of the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on Saturday, August 15.

angles.name: Jonas Brother Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Joe Jonas turns 37 this Saturday. What's your go-to Jonas Brothers or DNCE track?

moments.title: Madonna Turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday on Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Madonna this Sunday! From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', she's truly an icon. What's your favourite era?

moments.title: Ian Gillan's 81st Birthday
moments.blurb: Deep Purple's legendary lead singer, Ian Gillan, will celebrate his 81st birthday on Monday, August 19.

angles.name: Smoke On The Water
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 81st Birthday to Deep Purple's iconic frontman, Ian Gillan, this Monday! What's your favourite rock anthem featuring his incredible vocals?

moments.title: John Deacon Turns 75
moments.blurb: Queen's bassist and songwriter, John Deacon, who penned hits like 'Another One Bites the Dust' and 'I Want to Break Free', turns 75 on Monday, August 19.

angles.name: Queen Bassist
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary John Deacon this Monday! The quiet genius behind some of Queen's biggest hits. What's your favourite Deacon-penned track?

moments.title: Perseid Meteor Shower Peaks
moments.blurb: The annual Perseid meteor shower is currently active and expected to peak around mid-August, offering a spectacular skywatching opportunity under a new moon.

angles.name: Stargazing Alert
angles.copy: Look up tonight! The Perseid meteor shower is peaking this month, offering a brilliant display of shooting stars. Perfect for a late summer night!

moments.title: Partial Solar Eclipse
moments.blurb: August 2026 brings a total solar eclipse, which will be visible as a partial solar eclipse across parts of the UK.

angles.name: Eclipse Watch
angles.copy: Keep an eye on the sky this August! While a total solar eclipse will be seen elsewhere, we'll get a partial eclipse in the UK. When will you be looking up?

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Countdown
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just under three weeks away, falling on Monday, August 31, 2026.

angles.name: Long Weekend Planning
angles.copy: Start planning! The Summer Bank Holiday is on Monday, August 31st for England, Wales & Northern Ireland. How are you spending your extra day off?
